title: Obsidian Help: Graph view
summary: Notes are graph vertices and internal links form edges; the local graph exposes a bounded neighborhood.
limitations: A visual graph does not establish semantic truth, a neural mechanism, or automatic retrieval quality.

title: Obsidian Help: Backlinks
summary: Backlinks expose incoming note links; unlinked mentions are a separate lexical discovery feature.
limitations: A textual mention is not an authored relation or independent evidence.

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
summary: Combines extracted knowledge graphs and personalized PageRank for associative retrieval.
limitations: Brain-inspired architecture and reported benchmarks do not constitute a biological model or a universal ranking guarantee.

title: From RAG to Memory: Non-Parametric Continual Learning for Large Language Models
summary: HippoRAG 2 integrates passages, query-sensitive seeds, and recognition filtering into graph retrieval.
limitations: The paper reports task-specific gains; its model, dataset, and context budgets are part of the claim.

title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
summary: Entity graphs and community summaries support corpus-wide questions.
limitations: Summary construction can discard evidence and needs separate cost and faithfulness evaluation.

title: The evolution of GraphRAG: Advancing systems and evaluation together
summary: November 2026 describes embedding-derived GraphRAG Zero and evidence-oriented loop evaluation.
limitations: Provider study, product deployment, and independent benchmark replication are different evidence levels.

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
summary: Temporal graph relationships preserve changing facts and support time-aware retrieval.
limitations: Vendor-authored benchmark results depend on the evaluated configuration; no reproduction was run here.

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
summary: Extracts, consolidates, and retrieves memories, including a graph variant.
limitations: Reported LoCoMo results cannot be transferred directly to different models, judges, or later product versions.

title: Hindsight is 20/20: Building Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects
summary: Separates memory categories and combines lexical, semantic, graph, and temporal retrieval.
limitations: This atlas implements a smaller deterministic baseline, not the full Hindsight system.

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
summary: Tests extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention.
limitations: A retrieval fixture in this repository is not a LongMemEval benchmark run.

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
summary: Treats limited model context and external storage as different memory tiers.
limitations: The operating-system comparison is architectural; context movement does not prove correctness.

title: Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities
summary: Associative retrieval can be described through dynamics toward stable states of a recurrent network.
limitations: Energy descent requires specific symmetry and update assumptions; it is not literal thermodynamic energy by default.

title: What Learning Systems do Intelligent Agents Need? Complementary Learning Systems Theory Updated
summary: Contrasts rapid episodic acquisition with gradual structured learning and replay.
limitations: A software ledger/summary division is an engineering analogy, not a validated hippocampal simulation.

title: Hopfield Networks is All You Need
summary: Relates a continuous-state associative update to attention under the paper's model.
limitations: Capacity results have mathematical assumptions; they do not mean unlimited factual memory in an application.

title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: Introduces the Transformer architecture with scaled dot-product attention.
limitations: Attention weights are computational mixing weights, not guaranteed faithful explanations.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual Rank Learning Methods
summary: Combines ranked lists using reciprocal rank contributions.
limitations: The implementation uses explicit custom weights; the original paper does not certify those weights for this corpus.

title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
summary: Provides the probabilistic retrieval background for BM25 and related rankers.
limitations: The catalogue uses a stated positive-IDF BM25 variant; exact tokenization and constants matter.

title: The PageRank Citation Ranking: Bringing Order to the Web
summary: A random-walk ranking assigns graph vertices importance from link structure.
limitations: Original report locator was discovered; the derivation here is independently supplied and parameterized.

title: Python documentation: functools
summary: Memoization and bounded LRU caching reuse function results.
limitations: Side effects, mutable dependencies, argument equality, and concurrent duplicate calls still require care.

title: Efficient stack distance computation for priority replacement policies
summary: Stack distance characterizes misses for inclusion replacement policies and connects to the original 1970 analysis.
limitations: The LRU condition assumes a fully associative cache of uniform-sized items and a specified trace.

title: SQLite isolation
summary: Describes transaction isolation, serialized writers, and WAL snapshot behavior.
limitations: The implemented snapshot store uses filesystem files; it does not inherit SQLite transactional or crash-durability guarantees.

title: SQLite write-ahead logging
summary: WAL separates appended changes from checkpointed database pages.
limitations: Same-host shared memory and filesystem restrictions matter; WAL is a future storage option, not installed by this atlas.

title: OpenAI API documentation: Prompt caching
summary: Provider cache reporting includes cached-token telemetry and model-dependent cache behavior.
limitations: No provider request was made by the memory implementation; local cache hits cannot establish provider savings.

title: Graphiti project
summary: An implementation family for temporal knowledge graphs and agent retrieval.
limitations: Project discovery is not installation or performance verification.

title: Foam project
summary: Links Markdown knowledge notes within a VS Code-oriented workflow.
limitations: Compatibility with every extension or graph feature has not been tested.

title: Logseq project
summary: A knowledge-management project with linked blocks and graph-oriented workflows.
limitations: Storage formats and current application versions need their own migration check.

title: Daftar graph-memory implementation and executed tests
summary: Original deterministic scoped retrieval, explicit snapshots, cache tests, and note export created for this atlas.
limitations: A local engineering baseline, not a state-of-the-art benchmark or a general biological memory theory.
